name: Infoblox — DNS C2 Beacon (Recurring Domain Queries)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Response"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null and xdm.network.dns.dns_question.name != null
| alter domain = xdm.network.dns.dns_question.name
| bin _time span = 15m
| comp count() as queries, values(xdm.target.ipv4) as answers
       by xdm.source.ipv4, domain, _time
| filter queries >= 10
| alter c2_ip = arrayindex(arrayfilter(answers, "@element" != null), 0)
| alter dns_app = "DNS"
| join type = left (
    dataset = microsoft_windows_raw
    | filter _raw_log contains "4624" and _raw_log contains "IpAddress"
    | alter logon_ip = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='IpAddress'>([\d\.]+)<"), 0),
            user_name = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='TargetUserName'>([^<]+)<"), 0),
            host_name = arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "Name='WorkstationName'>([^<]+)<"), 0)
    | filter logon_ip != null and user_name != null
    | comp values(user_name) as user_name, values(host_name) as host_name by logon_ip
    | fields logon_ip, user_name, host_name
  ) as wbind wbind.logon_ip = xdm.source.ipv4
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, c2_ip, user_name, host_name, domain, dns_app, queries
description: Repeated DNS queries from one client to the same domain — beacon pattern.
alert_name: Infoblox — DNS C2 Beacon (Recurring Domain Queries)
